plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: 대화에서 역할별 에이전트를 띄운다. 대상 레포의 블랙보드(docs/reports/records/<subject>/<역할>.md)를 읽어 각 역할의 loop_state 와 계약 §3 이 누구를 깨웠는지 보여주고, 그 역할의 룰북 플러그인만 깔린 샌드박스 세션으로 일을 맡긴다. 보드는 읽기만 한다 — 전이는 각 룰북의 게이트가 한다.

plugins.name: freelunch
plugins.description: Speed-first plugin that forces every task onto concurrent background Sonnet agents with zero idle time

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Output-token compression scoped to conversational prose — never worker prompts, contracts, code, or safety-critical text. Three levels via /terse.

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Archetype-based architecture selection from a queryable database: deterministic classify/recommend CLI, anti-pattern checks, and the fan-out contract to freeze before dispatching workers.

plugins.name: no-mock
plugins.description: Steers deliverables toward production-runnable structure at generation time — real persistence, real integration seams, no silent mocks. Pure direction, no verification machinery.

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Pre-build reconnaissance: identify best-in-class exemplars and the customer expectation baseline (Camp benchmarking + Kano + saturation stop rule), compress into a scout brief that steers the build. Bounded and judgment-gated — never a research report, never post-build comparison.

plugins.name: no-footgun
plugins.description: Direction-only security steering: names the threat patterns for the surface being built so the secure pattern is chosen at write time — surface-gated, cascading custom rules, zero review passes or scans.

plugins.name: doctrine
plugins.description: Documentation placement doctrine: six lifetime-based buckets under docs/, created on session start, a directive that classifies at write time and records decisions/measurements as they happen, and a PreToolUse gate refusing writes under docs/ outside them.

plugins.name: warrant
plugins.description: Work-unit protocol: one approval gate at the front, then uninterrupted execution. A proposal states the request, the constraints, and the write set; approval freezes it; a PreToolUse gate refuses edits outside it and commits without the Proposal: trailer; SessionStart rebuilds state from the repository.

plugins.name: dispatch
plugins.description: Chat-to-git record-keeping discipline: when you work through chat, the conversation becomes the durable git record — a requirement becomes an issue, the work a pull request that Closes it, feedback becomes PR comments — and a PR merges only on an explicit, recorded user approval. Direction only, no gates, so a person or agent with no memory of the session can reconstruct intent, work, and rationale from git alone.

plugins.name: coding-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle: installs the whole tokenmaxxxer steering stack via dependencies.

plugins.name: intake
plugins.description: Per-project QA profile: /qa-init scans the target project once — issue tracker repo, issue templates, labels, app launch method, test conventions — and freezes it into qa/intake.md, which every other QA plugin reads. Committed to the project repo so every user shares one profile.

plugins.name: testrun
plugins.description: Test execution: launches the actual product and exercises it — plan-driven when a plan exists, ad-hoc smoke otherwise. Every verdict carries evidence (command output, screenshot, log); run records land under qa/runs/. Report, don't fix: findings become issues, never edits to product code.

plugins.name: bugreport
plugins.description: Bug filing discipline: a confirmed, actually-reproduced defect becomes a tracker issue that follows the project's own issue template and labels (per qa/intake.md), with duplicate search before filing and a standard form as fallback.

plugins.name: stats
plugins.description: Trust accounting: /qa-stats follows every issue filed from the workspace's run records to its tracker outcome and reports the stack's production signal — acceptance rate (fixed), noise rate (closed not-planned), duplicate conversions, UNFILED reasons. Read-only, no hooks.

plugins.name: regress
plugins.description: Regression tests with an adoption gate: /regress turns a confirmed bug into an automated test adopted only if it fails on the bug commit and passes stably (k=5) on the fix. Adopted tests live in the QA workspace and run on every /testrun; anything that can't prove itself is discarded, not committed.

plugins.name: qa-cycle
plugins.description: The QA cycle spine: owns the session state file (projects/<owner>-<repo>/state.md) and the PreToolUse gate that refuses any write the transition table in docs/specs/qa-cycle-state-machine.md disallows for the current phase. Human-only transitions require a matching unconsumed verdict token minted by signoff.

plugins.name: signoff
plugins.description: Human sign-off: /go-no-go records a Go/No-Go/Shipped-Under-Exception verdict against an exit-readiness bundle. Captures an unambiguous verdict from the user's own turn as a single-use token that authorizes exactly one qa-cycle transition.

plugins.name: qa-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install QA environment bundle: pulls in the whole tokenmaxxxer QA stack (intake, testrun, bugreport, stats, regress, qa-cycle, signoff) as dependencies. Contains no code of its own.

plugins.name: product-cycle
plugins.description: Product-discovery state machine: idle -> scoping -> researching -> hypothesis-registered -> measuring -> decided. Registers the metric, threshold, and decision rule before any data is collected; the gated hypothesis-registered -> measuring transition requires both the registered package and an approval token minted from the user's own turn; the threshold is frozen once measuring starts; decided applies the registered rule mechanically.

plugins.name: product-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle: installs product-cycle via dependency.

plugins.name: feasibility-cycle
plugins.description: Feasibility role cycle: takes a specification only (deliberately without the market argument), runs four sequential probes (technical, prior art, legal/regulatory, threat model), and gates entry into a verdict on all four being resolved. A UserPromptSubmit hook mints an approval token only from the user's own turn; a PreToolUse hook gates the state file's transitions against the token and the probe fields, evaluated on the target path regardless of which tool wrote it.

plugins.name: feasibility-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle for the feasibility role: installs feasibility-cycle via dependency. Contains no code of its own.

plugins.name: ops-cycle
plugins.description: The ops role's state machine: idle -> readiness -> rollout -> steady -> incident. A UserPromptSubmit hook mints an approval token only from the user's own turn; a PreToolUse gate refuses readiness -> rollout without every checklist item resolved to yes/no with a pointable artifact, refuses rollout -> steady without a matching approval token, and mechanically refuses any release transition out of steady once the error budget is recorded exhausted.

plugins.name: ops-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle for the ops role: installs ops-cycle via dependency. Contains no code of its own.

plugins.name: reflect-cycle
plugins.description: Reflect record state machine: idle -> reflecting -> done. Wakes after a subject's work has landed and verify and/or review have concluded (a verify-record reaching `cleared`, or a review-record reaching `reported`); the reflect-record must carry a non-empty pointer to the other role records it read; its findings are advisory only per contract §5.

plugins.name: reflect-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle: installs reflect-cycle via dependency.

plugins.name: review-cycle
plugins.description: The review role's state machine: idle -> scoped -> auditing -> reported. Per-requirement verdicts (Present, Surface, Absent, Incorrect) gate the move to reported; a standing refusal rule keeps the role from ever reading the building agent's intent or proposal prose.

plugins.name: review-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle for the review role: installs review-cycle via dependency. Contains no code of its own.

plugins.name: ux-design-cycle
plugins.description: UX-design record state machine: idle -> drafting -> reviewed. Wakes after a new/changed product-record (or a chain-root hypothesis); the ux-design-record must carry a non-empty pointer to its governing hypothesis/product-record; reaching `loop_state: reviewed` is what wakes coding per contract §3.

plugins.name: ux-design-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle: installs ux-design-cycle via dependency.

plugins.name: verify-cycle
plugins.description: The verify role's state machine: idle -> reproducing -> reproduced -> cleared. Adversarial reproduction of defects coding and qa may have missed, gated by transition-rules.md; blocking findings addressed to coding are not overridden by a clean review-record.

plugins.name: verify-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle for the verify role: installs verify-cycle via dependency. Contains no code of its own.
